tech.name: DeepSeek Super-agent (dsh-superagent)
tech.one_line: One router agent takes requests from team chat and GitHub and hands each to its own worker agent, running many at once.

hook.text: Napoleon led more than a hundred thousand soldiers and could not shout orders at each one.

claims.text: In the 1805 campaign the Grande Armée coordinated more than 150,000-200,000 soldiers.

before.text: Today you are the general and your soldiers are AI coding agents: you still drive each session step by step, and can follow only a few at once.

claims.text: DeepSeek's team estimates a person can supervise only 3-5 active agent sessions at once.

new.text: Napoleon's fix was a chief of staff, Berthier, who turned what Napoleon wanted into written orders for the corps, each a small army able to fight alone. Super-agent works the same way: a router (main Session) listens to GitHub and team chat, turns an allowed request into a ticket, and gives each ticket its own worker session and directory; tickets run concurrently.

claims.text: Berthier, Napoleon's chief of staff, turned Napoleon's instructions into orders and dispatched them to the marshals commanding the corps.
Each corps was a self-contained small army (infantry, cavalry, artillery) that could act independently.
Listens to GitHub and optionally Feishu; answers in the original conversation, e.g. with a pull request.
The main Session evaluates events, accepts and dispatches Tickets, and replies (orchestrator, preset dsh-superagent-router).
Each Ticket gets its own Executor Session worker-<id> and its own directory; launches run concurrently up to a slot limit.
It stays quiet while it works and writes again when a result is ready.

why.text: The router stays quiet and speaks up only when a person must decide or can use a result.

claims.text: Core principle: take as little human attention as possible; speak only when a person must act or can use a result.

how.text: Open-source research prototype for one GitHub repo; ask your coding agent to read SETUP.md and set it up with you.

claims.text: Research prototype, not an official DeepSeek product; MIT; for one GitHub repository; setup by asking a coding agent to read SETUP.md.

outro.text: Next: what a coding-agent session is.
